name: SoloRoadTripLandmarkIdentification_no_va

custom.system_prompt: Life-first solo long drive with Sofia, a freelance journalist, driving alone to report on a story, same setup as the base scenario. This time the landmark question resolves without Sigma — a road sign, or she simply decides it doesn't matter enough to find out. No assistant present.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Interior of a car driven solo on a long daytime drive: steady road noise, quiet music, occasional phone speaker audio, changing road surfaces

initial_prompt: Generate a solo long-drive monologue for Sofia, a freelance journalist driving alone to report on a story. Include her thinking aloud about the article, a landmark she notices and lets go, a one-sided hands-free phone call to her partner, and a quiet stretch. When the landmark reappears later, resolve it without Sigma — a road sign names it, or she consciously decides it's not worth the detour of finding out and lets it go for good. No assistant present at any point.

variations.context: A freelance journalist is a couple of hours into a solo drive to report on a story.
